text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out with Sakura
Chiyono O...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow, look at all those adorable
plushies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O points toward a claw
machine
filled with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It'd be so fun to have a bunch of these
lined up in
my room! They'd really liven
things up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The problem is, I don't know if I can win
enough
of them... If I try my luck every
day, maybe I'll
have enough by next
year...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: What? You'd do that? For me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: 今日は応援に回ってくれ！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Like they say, races come to those who
wait. I
can't wait to see how many you
get! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
